# Frontend Project Setup - Blockchain DID System

## Project Type
React + Vite frontend for blockchain-based Decentralized Identity (DID) system

## Tech Stack
- React 18+ with Vite
- ethers.js for blockchain interaction
- axios for API calls
- zod for validation
- Material-UI (MUI) for UI components
- zustand for state management
- react-router-dom for routing
- notistack for toast notifications
